regions.merged_text: Mrs. Irene (Wines) Keeler - 30 - T.B. Eleven yrs ago, "cured" .... Married, blessed with beautiful little daughter now five. Lost a secon child. Now over three years T.B. again. Has had three major operations since April 21st losing nine ribs, etc. Now quite hopeless in oxigin coop - inscribed for " .. .... big surprise". in Ser. Mass As'n.
